versions.changelog:
Initial release: provides an automated six-dimension quality evaluation tool for skills.

- Implements structured T/C/O/E/M/U dimensional scoring and reporting
- Generates actionable evaluation reports and prioritized improvement suggestions (P0/P1/P2)
- Includes pre-listing quality checklist for ClawHub
- Adopts design patterns: Evaluation Factory, Progressive Disclosure, and Six-Dimensions Model
- Supports both single and batch skill evaluation via CLI
